limitations: Task-local prototype only; it does not change the selected canonical authority, catalog entry, approval state, or training admission.
path_tiebreak=canonical_udlr is the exact base canonical Racket source after stripping outer whitespace.
Only equal-length BFS branch order varies; endpoints, walls, reachability, shortest-path objective, endpoint preservation, and cyan interior painting remain fixed.
Every retained input passes the selected production generator self_check, has a Manhattan-length route under both policies, and separates their outputs.
Evidence covers one episode per setting, 2-6 demonstrations, exactly four distinct queries, and the single declared rival.
Finite pairwise evidence does not prove uniqueness against arbitrary ARC programs or behavior outside the parent-generator domain.

dependent_input_constraints: input passes the selected production generator self_check
both row and column endpoint displacements are nonzero
both declared policies retain a Manhattan-length path
the two declared settings produce different outputs on every retained input
invariant_reasoning_steps: find the unique red start and green goal
run breadth-first search through non-wall orthogonal neighbors
reconstruct one shortest path from the first discovered parents
paint only the path interior cyan while preserving endpoints and walls
parameter_contract.name: path_tiebreak
parameter_contract.sampling_unit: once per episode from a rule-only deterministic seed stream

(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (same-pos? a b)
      (and (= (fst a) (fst b)) (= (snd a) (snd b))))
    (define (pos-in? p lst)
      (any? (lambda (q) (same-pos? p q)) lst))
    (define (parent-of p parents)
      (let ((hit (find-first (lambda (entry) (same-pos? p (first entry))) parents)))
        (if hit (second hit) #f)))
    (define (reconstruct goal parents)
      (let loop ((cur goal) (acc (list)))
        (let ((prev (parent-of cur parents)))
          (if prev
              (loop prev (cons cur acc))
              (cons cur acc)))))
    (define (shortest-path start goal)
      (let loop ((visited (list))
                 (queue (list start))
                 (parents (list (list start #f))))
        (if (empty? queue)
            (list)
            (let ((cur (first queue))
                  (restq (cdr queue)))
              (cond
                [(pos-in? cur visited) (loop visited restq parents)]
                [(same-pos? cur goal) (reconstruct goal parents)]
                [else
                 (let* ((new-visited (cons cur visited))
                        (r (fst cur))
                        (c (snd cur))
                        (neighbors
                          (filter
                            (lambda (n)
                              (let ((nr (fst n)) (nc (snd n)))
                                (and (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
                                     (not (= (cell-at g nr nc) 5))
                                     (not (pos-in? n new-visited))
                                     (not (pos-in? n restq)))))
                            (map
                              (lambda (d) (list (+ r (fst d)) (+ c (snd d))))
                              cardinal-deltas))))
                   (loop new-visited
                         (append restq neighbors)
                         (append parents (map (lambda (n) (list n cur)) neighbors))))])))))
    (let* ((start (first (find-color g 2)))
           (goal (first (find-color g 3)))
           (path (shortest-path start goal))
           (interior
             (filter
               (lambda (p) (not (or (same-pos? p start) (same-pos? p goal))))
               path)))
      (paint-cells g interior 8))))
